annotations.title: Convert a report to a file

description: Converts a report (RDL or RDLC) or Markdown (a document, or slides) with SSRS2 (Report Viewer's rules) to pptx (PowerPoint's own text boxes, tables and pictures, a slide per page: a Markdown deck becomes a deck), pdf, docx, xlsx, mhtml, tiff, png (the first page), csv or xml. It is checked first, as validate_report checks it: with errors nothing is written. Returns validate_report's answer and written: the file's name and size, url (downloaded once, within ten minutes), curl (the command that saves it), and what it holds read back as PowerPoint (slides) or Word and a PDF reader (document) get it. help: ["answers"] says more.

culture.description: The culture of a report that names no Language (en-US, de-CH); left out, en-US.

format.description: pptx (default), pdf, docx, xlsx, mhtml, tiff, png, csv or xml.

help.description: true, or topics (["markdown", "decks"]): the reference only.

markdown.description: Markdown's text: a document, or slides with marp: true. Give rdlc or markdown.

name.description: The file's name, without its extension (default: the Markdown's title, else report).

parameters.description: Report parameter values by name (a multi-value one's separated by commas).

pictures.description: The pictures the Markdown names, by its paths: {"images/chart.png": "<base64>"}; 5 MB each, 20 MB in all.

rdlc.description: The report definition's XML (RDL or RDLC). Give rdlc or markdown.

sampleData.description: Rows per dataset: {"DataSet": [{"Field": value}]}, dates as ISO text. Left out, made up from the fields' types.

name: convert_report
title: Convert a report to a file
